title: Coefficient comparison isomorphisms for the base-change source and target
statement: For the rings, schemes, cartesian square, degree and sheaf in lem-sbc-base-change-restrict-scalars-arrow, there are isomorphisms between the source and target objects of the restricted-scalar base-change map and the restricted-scalar images of the corresponding source and target objects over Λ′, and the two isomorphisms make the base-change square commute.

source.place: Lemma 21.20.7(3), Tag 0D6J: coefficient-independent derived direct image; Remark 21.19.3, Tag 07A7: exchange via adjunction; assembled as the change-of-rings step of Coefficients.lean

proof.text: Construct canonical source and target isomorphisms on bounded below derived categories from the inverse-image comparison and inverse direct-image comparison. Place the Λ′-sheaf G in degree zero, and transport from the degree-zero inclusion of Res_φ G using mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor.
Use the canonical derived exchange equality, then naturality of the Λ-base-change transformation for the degree-zero coefficient isomorphism, to obtain the derived commutative square.

Apply the degree-q homology functor to the endpoint isomorphisms and commutative square. Compose with the inverse of mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso. Naturality of this last isomorphism transports the equality to the restricted-scalar homology map. This produces the two existential witnesses and the required equality for every integer q.

proof_origin.place: Canonical derived endpoint comparisons, single-functor transport, exchange equality and homology naturality; V1 stage 3.

lean.statement: theorem restrictScalars_baseChange_comparison {Λ Λ' : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [CommRing Λ'] (φ : Λ →+* Λ') {X S T Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ S} {g : T ⟶ S} {e : Y ⟶ T} {h : Y ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback e h g p) [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g] (q : ℤ) (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ')) : ∃ (a : (baseChangeSourceFunctor Λ p g q).obj ((Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj G) ≅ (Sheaf.restrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj ((baseChangeSourceFunctor Λ' p g q).obj G)) (b : (baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ e h q).obj ((Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj G) ≅ (Sheaf.restrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj ((baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ' e h q).obj G)), a.hom ≫ (Sheaf.restrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ).map (baseChangeHomologyMap Λ' sq q G) = baseChangeHomologyMap Λ sq q ((Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj G) ≫ b.hom
